decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - This consent is for the temporary period from June 22nd 2026 to September 30th 2026 only and the installations the subject of this consent shall be removed and the site made good on or before 30th September 2026.

Reason: The type of structure is not one that the Council is prepared to approve, other than for a limited period, in view of its appearance. The permanent retention of the structure would be contrary to the requirements of policy D1 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved drawings and documents: 

Screen Specification Document, 2228-02 Rev 00, ADI LED Chair Summer Screen 15m2 Rev R1, 103-NEX-A-2001-R0-Site Location Plan Rev R2, 103-NEX-A-2002-R2E-Site Plan, 103-NEX-A-2002-R0-Site Plan, Screen Management Plan June to September 2026, Regents Summer Specification. 

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.

Condition : 3 - The LED screen shall not be on outside of the following times: 

- Monday - Friday: 9:00 hours to 21:00 hours 
- Saturday: 10:00 hours to 18:00 hours 
- Sunday: 10:00 hours to 16:00 hours 

Reason: In order to enable the Council to control the effects of the advertisement on the amenity of the area in accordance with policy D4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017

Condition : 4 - The external noise level emitted from proposed LED screen at the development shall not exceed LAeq,15min 67dB at 12 m from the screen operating at maximum capacity and thereafter be permanently retained for the consented time period.

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise from mechanical installations/ equipment in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.

Condition : 5 - The illumination of the proposed LED screen shall comply with the recommendations of the Institution of Lighting Professionals in the 'CIE guidance 2003 & 2017 and the ILP Guidance Notes for the Reduction of Obtrusive Light (2021)' and the 'Technical Report No 5, 1991 - Brightness of Illuminated Advertisements'. 
   
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of surrounding premises is not adversely affected by artificial lighting.
description: Erection of a structure incorporating an LED screen for temporary period from 22 June until 30 September 2026
